overview.title: Overview
body: Key metrics summarize the selected time range. Choose a metric to chart it, and turn on Compare to overlay the previous period of the same length.
Deltas compare the latest month with the month before the range starts. Percent metrics change in percentage points (pp).
items: Select a region on the donut or in the top navigation to filter accounts and activity.
Hover the trend chart, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to inspect months.

metrics.title: Key metrics
body: MRR is monthly recurring revenue. Trial conversion is the share of trials that became paid within 30 days. D30 retention is the share of new users still active 30 days after signup.

activity.title: Live activity
body: Account events stream in while live activity is on. Pause it from this container or from the footer. Events follow the selected region.

customers.title: Customers
body: Named accounts across plans, owners and regions. Filters combine, and the region from the top navigation applies here too.
Select rows to export or star them in bulk from Actions. Choose a row to open account details.
items: Press / to jump to the search field.
Health combines seat usage, activity and billing signals into a score out of 100.

account.title: Account details
body: MRR history, seat usage, renewal date and key moments for one account. Notes are saved in this browser only.
Previous and next follow the current order and filters of the customers table.

analytics.title: Analytics
body: The funnel shows each step's conversion from the one before and from the top of the funnel. Tabs split it by acquisition channel.
Cohort retention shows the share of each monthly signup cohort still active in later months. MRR movement breaks last month's net change into new, expansion, contraction and churn.

settings.title: Settings
body: Theme, density and motion call Cloudscape's applyMode, applyDensity and disableMotion helpers. All preferences are stored in this browser.
